title: Rewrite lifecycle and persistence test suite
description: Replace legacy implementation tests with reducer property-like cases, lifecycle fault matrix, restart/tree/fork/compaction coverage, and end-to-end mock adapter tests. Acceptance: deterministic full suite passes.
